item.title: Vacancy-mediated ultrafast oxide-ion conduction in excess-oxygen Sillén oxybromides
item.description:

Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 Bi₁.₉Te₀.₁LaO₄.₀₅Br achieves 0.01 S cm⁻¹ oxide-ion conductivity at 233 °C, surpassing leading proton and oxide-ion conductors. Its layered Sillén structure with oxygen vacancies enables vacancy-mediated transport despite excess oxygen, plus high stability and negligible chemical expansion. This establishes a design principle for high-performance oxide-ion conductors in excess-oxygen Sillén oxyhalides.

item.title: Morphology and Ion Transport in Zwitterionic Polysiloxanes
item.description:

ACS Nano | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study challenges the assumption that superionic conductivity is universal in doped polyzwitterions, showing it requires percolating ion channels. Using polysiloxane-based PZI with LiTFSI, isolated zwitterionic nanodomains limited conductivity to ~10⁻⁸ S/cm; overlap of these clusters enabled significant enhancement. The findings establish morphological control of ion-transport pathways as critical for designing superionic polymer electrolytes.

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study uniquely links C-rate capacity decay in Mn-doped Fe-PBA cathodes to coupled kinetic mismatch and mechanical failure, rather than isolated transition metal dissolution. By combining multiple in/ex situ techniques, it identifies four degradation pathways—dissolution, mechanical degradation, Na dendrites, and interfacial side reactions—revealing that high-rate collapse at 10 C is fundamentally driven by intrinsic kinetic and mechanical limitations, guiding durable high-power SIB design.

item.title: Regulating Chemomechanical Interactions in a High-Compaction Na4Fe3(PO4)2P2O7 Cathode for Durable Sodium Storage
item.description:
دوپینگ La در کاتد NFPP تنش مکانیکی و کرنش شبکه را کاهش داده و ظرفیت 90.4 mAh g–1 با پایداری 5000 چرخه را ممکن می‌سازد.
Nano Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This work regulates chemomechanical failure in high-compaction Na4Fe3(PO4)2P2O7 by La doping, which refines grains, strengthens Fe–O bonds, and suppresses microcracks and lattice strain. The optimized cathode delivers 90.4 mAh g–1 at 10 C with 92.2% retention over 5000 cycles, plus wide-temperature pouch-cell stability, offering a practical route to durable, high-energy sodium-ion batteries.
🏷 Na4Fe3(PO4)2P2O7 · sodium-ion battery · cathode · chemomechanical · La doping
